name: University of Nicosia
description: The University of Nicosia (UNIC) is the largest university in Cyprus, and the largest university in Southern Europe that teaches primarily in English. UNIC has over 12,500 enrolled students from over 80 countries. UNIC has been investing in developing a variety of unique programs and building research capabilities in Science, Engineering, Medicine, Law and Business. Timestamps Updated
